sourceCorrections.rationale: The northern and southern source cells form the single historic La Chaume district.
IGN names Les Chirons as a residential quarter at the representative point of the exact southern cell.
IGN validates the inhabited locality L'Allerie inside the exact cross-sector cell; the human place name replaces the contradictory direction pair.
The eastern and western statistical cells form one avenue district.
